decisions.statement: This value is read off the unit the collection names rather than stated on that collection.
The value read is the unit's own `words`.
The unit is reached by the address the collection names rather than by a slug.
A collection naming no unit is worth no words.
A collection whose unit is no page is worth no words.
A total counted in this unit is absent where the collection states no unit words.
A total counted in this unit is absent where the unit words are zero.

definition: how many words one of the collection's unit is worth
